text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after winning
many races alongside Fuji Kiseki――

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Do you remember the promise from that day?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty sure you promised we'd go on a hot springs trip
together once we had some free time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And Fuji Kiseki produced a hot spring trip voucher
out of thin air.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Now that we've both settled down, how about it?
I promise you a wonderful journey."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the travel dates were smoothly set—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the hot springs trip.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I hurriedly ran to the meeting spot, and—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, good morning, Trainer!
Over here, over here!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! It's okay. I already let the inn know,
so let's take our time.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
By the way, did you get to eat breakfast?
I went ahead and grabbed some takeout.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: If you'd like, let's eat together on the train.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Escorted by Fuji Kiseki,
we arrived at the inn—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
Good work today, were you able to relax?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad.
It's warmed me right to my core, it feels so nice.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And so, here.
Please enjoy this exceptionally delicious natural water♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even after that, Fuji Kiseki's flawless escorting continued—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There's a beautiful flower field over there, you know?
We still have time before dinner, so want to go take a look?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you make that look so delicious when you eat it, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: If you'd like, please have my portion too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before I knew it, she was holding my hand as we walked along a country path between the fields.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's a little dark here.
Watch your step!
choice_data_list: (I wonder if Fuji is getting enough rest?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I'm just going with the flow
and letting them fuss over me constantly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This trip is a relaxing getaway for the two of us.
I can't let it become exhausting for Fuji Kiseki!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Is something wrong, Trainer?
Sorry, were you already tired out?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It was pretty sudden, wanting to go on a walk like that.
Shall we head back to the inn?
choice_data_list: It's not really like that, but...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told Fuji Kiseki not to worry about me
and to let loose and relax more herself. When I did—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, is that all it was!
What a relief.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's okay, Trainer. You see,
nothing makes me happier than putting a smile on your face.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I got to see so many joyful smiles today,
my mind and body feel completely healed.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "So, let's see. If you really want me to spread my wings and relax—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And Fuji Kiseki casually snapped her fingers—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*whirrrrr~~*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A massive firework shot up into the sky!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I really hope she enjoys this trip from the bottom of her heart.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Did it startle you? Apparently there's a fireworks festival today.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Apparently, this place is a hidden gem.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As fireworks launch into the air one after another, the night sky is painted in dazzling beauty.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems taking me out for a walk was meant for that exact purpose. The timing was astonishingly spot-on.
choice_data_list: (...I wonder just how much research she did)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Considering everything she did today, none of it was something that could be achieved with just a little casual research."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I'm glad you had fun! Actually,
there's a bench over that way, so let's sit—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's the matter, Trainer?
Is there something on my face?
choice_data_list: Thank you for the wonderful memories.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
choice_data_list: I'm so happy you prepared so much for me.
I'm so happy you prepared so much for me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The breakfast, the flower garden, the fireworks... Fuji Kiseki's warm, heartfelt sincerity could be felt in all of it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I continued—
a faint blush appeared on Fuji Kiseki's cheeks.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, umm... sorry,
I'm just kind of happy. I mean—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I just wanted to make it a special day.
Maybe I overdid it a bit, though."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...I see. That's a relief, then.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
――
No, thank you for that wonderful smile.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I look forward to continuing to work with you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt
an irreplaceable bond
with Fuji Kiseki……
